title: Deep-learning screening finds MoEno1-targeting antifungal compounds for rice blast
summary: Isobavachalcone was identified as a hit and its derivative II-24 inhibited enolase, with efficacy shown in planta, in biochemical and fungal assays. Deep learning is one step in a longer pipeline.
ai_technology: Deep-learning affinity prediction combined with structure-based virtual screening

evidence.tested: Biochemical, fungal and in planta assays
evidence.unknown: Abstract only; DL is one step in a longer pipeline; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning affinity prediction with structure-based virtual screening to find MoEno1 binder

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
